source.title: WCA Regulations - January 2018
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the new version of the regulations, which is going into effect January 1, 2018.

You can review all changes in this [comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official...Fixes-2017). If you do not want to open all the individual changes, you can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the regulation and guidelines. All changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Most important changes for competitors:

* Puzzles with logos are not allowed to be used in blindfolded events ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/516/commits/3b8e7239ea5a3b10bbf0eabd1b93b9d469dd5265) | no public discussion)
* The format of “3x3x3 With Feet” is changed to “Average of 5”. The WRC and WCA Board will review how the format change influences the popularity of the event and decide about the future of the event after an internally determined period of time. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ee259ddee5b0862334f91339b57ccdb058ef5440) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/299))
* The result recording procedure has been revised: Judges must sign right after recording the result. Competitors have to check the result and sign after the judge has recorded the result and signed. The competitor is ultimately responsible for ensuring that they and the judge have signed an attempt. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/524/commits/3c3e9526c7a9cd8030520939652a57f7adf41b00) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/443))
* Electronic headphones and earbuds must not be used during an attempt, even if they are switched off or disconnected ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/483/files) | no public discussion)
* Competitors are now allowed to use their hands during inspection in 3x3x3 With Feet ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bd445f506a9d77c399b9ff4ca63aac679cb3a02b) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/460))
* Attempts done with illegal puzzles will be disqualified (DNF). Exception: If a puzzle is found to be not permitted during a round, earlier results may be replaced with an extra attempt, at the discretion of the WCA Delegate ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/516/commits/72afb6a8030a514b324baf845bcef8a7617f089c) | no public discussion)

Other important changes:
<!-- break -->
* All pillowed puzzles are allowed in all events ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/afddf80607fca22aa87f8a3388dd96a34a2e12c3) | [discussions](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/195))
* The default format for 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 With Feet, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, and Square-1 is “Average of 5” or “Best of 2/Average of 5” for a combined round. All other formats for these events have to be approved by the Board ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/479/commits/1d99d03b6c717334f75d9f291286a8c3f67d32bd) | no public discussion)
* When competitors  accidentally touch the puzzle with other body parts during 3x3x3 One-Handed Solving, it’s not considered DNF, at the discretion of the judge ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/511/commits/925d6a48878621ae9b3e53d573d62fd2853b3d0c) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/464))
* If the puzzle falls into the lap of the competitor after stopping the timer, this is considered touching the puzzle (thus, +2 seconds penalty is awarded) ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/4057d66c433e7dc3649c218a5f1e0dd73a1f0f61) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/464))
* Competitors are now allowed to talk to WCA Delegates during their attempts, not only to their judges ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/650625cfbad7104b4fd654c0c360c9810fe573cd) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/297))
* The interaction between A6c and A6e has been clarified: A6c does not trigger A6e anymore ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bd3ccdef5936960c357fa20bed4513eba2783ec2) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/373))
* Ranking-based cutoffs for combined rounds are removed (only result-based remains) ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/449/commits/8789fa6eab6b27140220d9543ec956d68b3aafe7) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/425))
* Advancement conditions to the next round must be announced before the current round starts and should not be changed later ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/a8c3bef750edef70c8181faa29c2c9058b12b7e9) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/391))
* A Stackmat must be used for all attempts, exception: the usage of a Stackmat is optional for events without inspection where the competitor is expected to exceed 10 minutes ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f455cb011584d94ee048a2f366701f9be1bdf1d1) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/375))
* In Multiple Blindfolded Solving, puzzles should be arranged in shape as square as possible (e.g. 8 puzzles should be arranged in 2 rows with 3 puzzles and 1 row with 2 puzzles) ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/315144c87794aa35cf319c03258cb2136a2bf21c) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/444))
* Three restrictions for registration management ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f30fffa659a9155a43e0b813a75e62e63a352e94) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/469)):
    1. If the competitor limit was reached, on-site registrations are not allowed
    2. Competitor limits should be announced and may only be changed with Board approval
    3. Additional registration periods must be announced at least 48 hours before they start

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则：2018 年 1 月更新
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 现公布新版竞赛规则，将于 2018 年 1 月 1 日生效。

全部改动可在 [GitHub 版本对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official...Fixes-2017)中查看。如果不想逐项打开修改，可点击“Files changed”查看完整的规则与指南文件。修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

与选手最相关的主要变化：

* 盲拧项目不允许使用带标志的魔方。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/516/commits/3b8e7239ea5a3b10bbf0eabd1b93b9d469dd5265)｜无公开讨论）
* 三阶脚拧赛制改为“五次去尾平均”。WRC 和 WCA 董事会将在内部确定的一段时间后，评估赛制变化对该项目受欢迎程度的影响，再决定该项目的未来。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ee259ddee5b0862334f91339b57ccdb058ef5440)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/299)）
* 调整成绩记录流程：裁判必须在记录成绩后立即签名；选手须在裁判记录并签名后核对成绩、签名。确保自己和裁判都已为该次还原签名，最终责任在选手。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/524/commits/3c3e9526c7a9cd8030520939652a57f7adf41b00)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/443)）
* 一次尝试期间不得使用电子头戴式或入耳式耳机，即使已关闭或断开连接也不例外。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/483/files)｜无公开讨论）
* 三阶脚拧观察期间，选手现可用手接触魔方。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bd445f506a9d77c399b9ff4ca63aac679cb3a02b)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/460)）
* 使用不合规魔方完成的成绩将被取消资格，记为 DNF。例外：若在轮次进行中发现魔方不合规，WCA 代表可酌情用补赛替代此前的成绩。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/516/commits/72afb6a8030a514b324baf845bcef8a7617f089c)｜无公开讨论）

其他重要变化：
<!-- break -->
* 所有项目均允许使用面包魔方。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/afddf80607fca22aa87f8a3388dd96a34a2e12c3)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/195)）
* 三阶、二阶、四阶、五阶、三阶单手、三阶脚拧、魔表、五魔方、金字塔、斜转和 Square-1 的默认赛制为“五次去尾平均”，组合轮次则为“两次取最佳／五次去尾平均”。这些项目采用其他赛制须获董事会批准。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/479/commits/1d99d03b6c717334f75d9f291286a8c3f67d32bd)｜无公开讨论）
* 三阶单手还原中，若选手意外用身体其他部位触碰魔方，裁判可酌情不判 DNF。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/511/commits/925d6a48878621ae9b3e53d573d62fd2853b3d0c)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/464)）
* 停表后魔方掉到选手大腿上，视为触碰魔方，因此加罚 2 秒。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/4057d66c433e7dc3649c218a5f1e0dd73a1f0f61)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/464)）
* 选手在一次尝试期间，除裁判外，现在也可以与 WCA 代表交谈。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/650625cfbad7104b4fd654c0c360c9810fe573cd)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/297)）
* 明确了 A6c 与 A6e 的关系：违反 A6c 不再同时触发 A6e。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bd3ccdef5936960c357fa20bed4513eba2783ec2)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/373)）
* 取消组合轮次按排名设置的及格线，只保留按成绩设置的及格线。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/449/commits/8789fa6eab6b27140220d9543ec956d68b3aafe7)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/425)）
* 晋级下一轮的条件必须在当前轮次开始前公布，之后不应更改。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/a8c3bef750edef70c8181faa29c2c9058b12b7e9)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/391)）
* 所有尝试必须使用 Stackmat；例外是没有观察时间、且预计选手用时超过 10 分钟的项目，可选择不使用 Stackmat。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f455cb011584d94ee048a2f366701f9be1bdf1d1)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/375)）
* 多盲的魔方应摆成尽量接近正方形的形状，例如 8 个魔方应分为三行，两行各 3 个、一行 2 个。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/315144c87794aa35cf319c03258cb2136a2bf21c)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/444)）
* 报名管理新增三项限制（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f30fffa659a9155a43e0b813a75e62e63a352e94)｜[讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/469)）：
  1. 达到人数上限后，不得再接受现场报名。
  2. 应公布人数上限，只有获董事会批准后才能更改。
  3. 额外开放报名时，必须至少提前 48 小时公告。
